name: Heat Pump Heating & Cooling Rebate
description: $1,500 rebate to replace gas heater/furnace with electric heat pump; CARE/FERA customers get additional $1,000
fullDescription: WestLight Energy (formerly Peninsula Clean Energy) offers rebates for San Mateo County and Los Banos homeowners to replace gas furnaces with efficient electric heat pumps that provide both heating and cooling.
whatTheyOffer:
- $1,500 rebate for a heat pump replacing a gas heater/furnace
- Additional $1,000 for CARE/FERA customers ($2,500 total)
- Additional $1,000 for an electrical panel upgrade
- Extra $1,500 for City of Menlo Park residents while funding lasts
- Provides both heating and air conditioning
- Can combine with other federal, state, and local incentives and the 0% loan
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a WestLight Energy customer and the legal owner of the property
2. Hire any contractor (self-installs also qualify) and get the required city permit
3. Take photos of your old equipment before it is replaced
4. Complete installation
5. Submit rebate application with itemized invoice, photos, and permit within 90 days
6. Receive rebate check after approval
keywords: heat pump, HVAC, rebate, WestLight Energy, Peninsula Clean Energy, PCE, San Mateo, heating, air conditioning, gas furnace, electrification
